correctness.rationale: With the impulse at index one, the binary recurrence gives F(z)=z/(1+z²+⋯+z^k) for n≥0 with coprime numerator and denominator. The state transition is invertible because the oldest bit has coefficient one. A scalar period T holds exactly when the reduced denominator divides 1+z^T: in the converse direction the numerator after clearing that denominator has degree 1+T−k<T. Reciprocation gives the unit order modulo C_k=x^k+sum_{i=0}^{k−2}x^i, and the scalar sequence equality extends to negative indices by invertibility. The derivative of (x+1)C_k=x^{k+1}+x^k+x^{k−1}+1 is x^{k−1} for odd k, and x^{k−2}(x+1)² for even k. The product has nonzero constant term, so in even order only x+1 can repeat. C_k(1)=0 and C'_k(1)=(k−2)/2 mod 2 for even k, giving a simple root if 4|k. Otherwise the product has multiplicity at least three, and cannot have multiplicity four or more because its derivative vanishes to exactly order two there. Thus C_k has exactly a square factor (x+1)² in that case, with squarefree part Q_k coprime to it. All orders in the squarefree quotient are odd; the squared factor contributes exact order two, including k=2 when Q_k=1. The divisibility C_k|(x+1)(x^{L_k}+1) says the difference of the sequence and its half-period shift is constant, and minimality excludes zero. Hence the flip holds on every index and gives exact balance only in this class.
residual_risks: Finite cycles corroborate the proof but do not replace it. All-order validity pertains only to the stated impulse conditions and modulus two; the odd factor is characterized by a polynomial order, not supplied as a closed function of k.

value.rationale: This classifies the exact 2-primary period of a standard recurrence uniformly in its order without computing its variable odd part. It explains why perfect binary balance occurs despite very different periods: there is an explicit involution on positions pairing every occurrence with its complement. This makes the result a structural statement on the impulse orbit rather than a finite table or parity spot check.
residual_risks: No uniform formula for odd factors, higher moduli or other initial seeds is established by this finding.
